headline: 电影新作与热门剧集齐发力
summary: 今日影市由《生化危机：爆发夜》等热作领跑，新剧《火线家族》《无间兄弟情》首播，热播剧《菜鸟老警》《龙族》持续吸睛，待映《复仇者联盟5》与待播《幻视任务》同样受关注。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《生化危机：爆发夜》《你我对抗全世界》等领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Film hits: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and Me Against the World lead the pack.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《火线家族》《无间兄弟情》今日开播。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Fireline Family and Infernal Brotherhood debut today.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》持续吸睛。
industryHighlights.en: Hit series: The Rookie, Rick and Morty and House of the Dragon keep drawing viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：《复仇者联盟5》《幻视任务》受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5 and Vision Quest are highly anticipated.

headlineEn: Film New Releases and Hit Series Heat Up
summaryEn: Today's film scene is led by Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and other hits, while new series Fireline Family and Infernal Brotherhood premiere; hot shows The Rookie and House of the Dragon stay strong, with Avengers 5 and Vision Quest also highly anticipated.
